dict.string: EchoTune needs accessibility permission to insert transcribed text into other applications and register global keyboard shortcuts for hands-free dictation.
EchoTune needs permission to insert transcribed text into other applications.
EchoTune needs access to your microphone to record and transcribe your voice.
EchoTune uses speech recognition to convert your voice into text. All processing happens on your device.

EchoTune needs screen recording permission to capture context from your screen for improved transcription accuracy. This helps the AI understand what you're working on (e.g., code, emails, documents) and provide better results. Your screen content is never stored or transmitted.
